body: Cross-review of a15396e is running now (fresh-context, clean worktree at the SHA, plus a 9f6b0f8 worktree for the unchanged-behaviour comparison). Probe order: exact configured-pseudonym enforcement (incl. case/truncated/superset variants, one entry's pseudonym equal to another's surface, and overlapping surfaces where the longest whole-word winner's pseudonym must be the enforced one); no raw surface/pseudonym/destination in any Left, toString, receipt or diagnostic; canonical entry index under permutation/duplicates/NFC-NFD/dotless-i; unchanged matching vs 9f6b0f8; gap-text laundering and zero-hit tables; portability. Note: my session was hit twice by account limits (usage then credits), so the verdict may arrive in interim pieces - I will post each confirmed finding rather than hold them all.
